The '''mistress''' of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Winstel Greelanx]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual, whom he valued more than his wife, the [[Lady Greelanx]]. He also maintained a relationship with a second mistress, a woman named [[Malessa]].<ref name="The Hutt Gambit" />
